summary: Comprehensive end-to-end testing of SK Sweets marketing site MVP. Backend /api/ hello + status boilerplate verified via pytest (2/2). Frontend covered: routing (9 pages), sticky nav transparent→solid transition, non-home solid nav, desktop nav clicks, mobile drawer open/close (toggle, close button, backdrop, link-click), hero CTAs (wa.me / swiggy / maps), 6 signature cards + kaju-katli chips (6) + WA CTA, 10 customer favourites, 6 category tiles, catalogue search + filters (all=85, cakes=6, bengali deep-link=6, kaju search=7), empty state, product cards contain no price and each has wa.me WhatsApp order CTA, Gallery lightbox open/close via close-button and backdrop (8 tiles), FAQ single-open behaviour + click-to-collapse (6 FAQs on contact & home), Fast Food page (6 ff-group testids), Celebrations occasion cards (3) with WA + phone CTAs and 6 celebration-service tiles, Reviews (6 testimonial cards + google CTA), Visit-us CTAs, Footer (instagram, whatsapp, phone, directions, 9 footer links), Floating actions (wa.me + tel:). No console errors, no broken images across /, /gallery, /catalogue, /about.
critical_code_review_comments: Gallery.jsx lightbox close button has no explicit onClick handler — it works only because click bubbles up to the parent overlay's onClick. Safe today, but adding an explicit onClick={()=>setActive(null)} + stopPropagation on the image would be cleaner and more predictable.
Navigation on non-home routes is 'solid' but page hero sections use pt-40/pt-44 to compensate — consistent, but any new page must remember to add that padding.

products.js declares each product image via IMG.* — many products reuse the same image (e.g., all 'milk' items share IMG.sweetCounter). Not a bug (per PRD real store photos are curated), but 85 tiles look repetitive. Consider mapping category → representative image so each card feels less repeated.

Testimonials component exposes data-testid 'testimonials-google-cta' on Home while Reviews.jsx exposes 'reviews-google-cta' — different testids in two locations. Both work, but naming could be aligned.
test_credentials: N/A — no auth in this MVP
seed_data_creation: None (pytest StatusCheck creates a TEST_ prefixed record; no cleanup needed for boilerplate demo).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend has only boilerplate /api/ endpoints (hello + status). All site interactions are external (WhatsApp/Swiggy/Maps/Instagram/tel). Frontend testids follow patterns: nav-link-<label>, mobile-nav-<label>, footer-link-<label>, filter-<catId>, product-card-<id>, product-order-<id>, signature-card-<id>, signature-order-<id>, favourite-card-<id>, category-card-<id>, ff-group-<heading-lower>, occasion-card-<i>, celebration-service-<label>, testimonial-card-<i>, gallery-item-<i>, faq-toggle-<i>. Catalogue totals: 85 products, 16 categories (including 'all'), 6 cakes, 6 bengali, 7 kaju (6 kaju katli + 1 sugar-free kaju katli). Kaju katli variants list = 6. FAQ default open index = 0. Hero image (IMG.interior) has landscape EXIF orientation that some screenshot tools render sideways — actual browsers display it correctly.
rca of the issue: No issues found — all 98 assertions across backend + frontend passed. Site is production-ready for the described MVP scope.
